newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Five N.Korean defectors to arrive in South Korea. [CORRECTED 13:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Five N.Korean defectors to arrive in South Korea. [CORRECTED 13:10 GMT]

text.p: Five North Koreans will arrive in Seoul on Thursday after being granted political asylum, South Korea's unification ministry said.
It identified three of the five as the mother, a younger sister and a younger brother (corrects from "two younger brothers") of Hong Jin-hi, 28, who defected to South Korea in January last year.
The other two were a 25-year-old college student and a 51-year-old member of the military who was in charge of earning hard currencies, a ministry statement said.
The five had stayed in a third country after defecting. The statement did not name the third country.
An increasing number of North Koreans, stricken by chronic food shortages, have been defecting and seeking political asylum in the capitalist South.
South and North Korea remain technically at war after their 1950-53 conflict ended with a truce rather than a peace accord.
